More ways to connect

## Don't see your system?

Connect it through Zapier, or build your own connection with the Levitate API. If your team works in an AI assistant, the Levitate MCP server connects it directly.

### Zapier

Connect thousands of apps to Levitate without writing any code.

[Learn more→](https://www.levitate.ai/integrations/zapier)

### Levitate API

Build your own connection. Personal API keys are limited to the access you choose and expire on a schedule you set.

[API documentation→](https://api.levitate.ai/docs)

### ChatGPT and Claude

Use ChatGPT or Claude? Connect it to Levitate through our MCP server.

[Learn more→](https://www.levitate.ai/integrations/mcp-server)
